title: Glycyrrhizic acid alleviates liver fibrosis in vitro and in vivo via activating CUGBP1-mediated IFN-gamma/STAT1/Smad7 pathway.
authors: Guo, Manman; Wang, Zhongda; Dai, Jinya; Fan, Haizhen; Yuan, Ningning; Gao, Liming; Peng, Huiping; Cheng, Xiaolan
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甘草酸通过CUGBP1介导的信号通路缓解肝纤维化，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatic fibrosis, a common pathological feature of chronic liver injuries, is a serious public health problem and lacks effective therapy. Glycyrrhizic acid (GA) is a bioactive ingredient in the root of traditional Chinese medicine licorice, and exhibits remarkable anti-viral, anti-inflammatory and hepatoprotective actions. PURPOSE: Here we aimed to investigated whether GA provided a therapeutic efficacy in hepatic fibrosis and uncover its molecular mechanisms. STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: We investigated the anti-fibrosis effects of GA using CCl(4)-induced mouse mode of liver fibrosis as well as TGF-beta1-activated human LX-2 cells and primary hepatic stellate cells (HSCs). CUGBP1-mediated IFN-gamma/STAT1/Smad7 signaling was examined with immunofluorescence staining and western blot analysis. We designed and studied the binding of GA to CUGBP1 using in silico docking, and validated by microscale thermophoresis (MST) assay. RESULTS: GA obviously attenuated CCl(4)-induced liver histological damage, and reduced serum ALT and AST levels. Meanwhile, GA decreased liver fibrogenesis markers such as alpha-SMA, collagen alpha1, HA, COL-III, and LN in the hepatic tissues. Mechanistically, GA remarkably elevated the levels of IFN-gamma, p-STAT1, Smad7, and decreased CUGBP1 in vivo and in vitro. Over-expression of CUGBP1 completely abolished the anti-fibrotic effect of GA and regulation on IFN-gamma/STAT1/Smad7 pathway in LX-2 cells and primary HSCs, confirming CUGBP1 played a pivotal role in the protection by GA from liver fibrosis. Further molecular docking and MST assay indicated that GA had a good binding affinity with the CUGBP1 protein. The dissociation constant (Kd) of GA and CUGBP1 was 0.293 muM. CONCLUSION: Our study demonstrated for the first time that GA attenuated liver fibrosis and hepatic stellate cell activation by promoting CUGBP1-mediated IFN-gamma/STAT1/Smad7 signalling pathways. GA may be a potential candidate compound for preventing or reliving liver fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝纤维化是慢性肝损伤的常见病理特征，是一个严重的公共卫生问题，且缺乏有效疗法。甘草酸（GA）是传统中药甘草根中的一种生物活性成分，具有显著的抗病毒、抗炎和保肝作用。目的：本研究旨在探讨GA是否对肝纤维化具有治疗功效，并揭示其分子机制。研究设计与方法：我们利用CCl(4)诱导的小鼠肝纤维化模型以及TGF-beta1激活的人LX-2细胞和原代肝星状细胞（HSCs），研究了GA的抗纤维化作用。通过免疫荧光染色和蛋白质印迹分析检测了CUGBP1介导的IFN-gamma/STAT1/Smad7信号通路。我们使用计算机模拟对接设计了GA与CUGBP1的结合，并通过微量热泳动（MST）实验进行了验证。结果：GA明显减轻了CCl(4)诱导的肝脏组织学损伤，并降低了血清ALT和AST水平。同时，GA降低了肝组织中的纤维化标志物，如alpha-SMA、胶原alpha1、HA、COL-III和LN。机制上，GA在体内和体外均显著提高了IFN-gamma、p-STAT1、Smad7的水平，并降低了CUGBP1。CUGBP1的过表达完全消除了GA的抗纤维化作用及其对LX-2细胞和原代HSCs中IFN-gamma/STAT1/Smad7通路的调控，证实CUGBP1在GA保护肝纤维化中发挥了关键作用。进一步的分子对接和MST实验表明，GA与CUGBP1蛋白具有良好的结合亲和力。GA与CUGBP1的解离常数（Kd）为0.293 muM。结论：我们的研究首次证明，GA通过促进CUGBP1介导的IFN-gamma/STAT1/Smad7信号通路，减轻了肝纤维化和肝星状细胞活化。GA可能成为预防或缓解肝纤维化的潜在候选化合物。
